capabilities.name: Strategic direction
capabilities.question: Which objectives do we pursue, and what do they mean for technology?

capabilities.name: Investment & funding
capabilities.question: How much money flows where, and within which guardrails?
capabilities.leadNote: EPM leads across the enterprise (portfolio budgets, guardrails, cross-portfolio investments); LPM then takes the lead within each portfolio (value stream funding). In the compact variant without a separate EPM level, LPM or an integrated portfolio governance leads throughout.

capabilities.name: Prioritisation & dependencies
capabilities.question: What do we do first, what not at all, and what depends on what?

capabilities.name: Cost transparency & allocation
capabilities.question: What does technology cost, for what, and who consumes it?

capabilities.name: Architecture & lifecycle
capabilities.question: Which target architecture, which technology is ending, which risks exist?

capabilities.name: Delivery & capacity
capabilities.question: How does work flow through limited capacity?

capabilities.name: Operations & service quality
capabilities.question: Do services run reliably, securely and economically?

capabilities.name: Value realisation & reallocation
capabilities.question: Does it work? What do we keep funding, change or stop?

cells.title: Enterprise objectives & investment themes
cells.detail: Translates enterprise strategy into a small set of [[strategic-objective|strategic objectives]] and investment themes that all portfolios work towards.

cells.title: Portfolio budgets & guardrails
cells.detail: Allocates the overall technology budget to portfolios and sets [[guardrail|guardrails]]. Decides on investments that span portfolios and splits their funding.

cells.title: Cross-portfolio sequencing
cells.detail: Sets the order of shared and cross-portfolio investments so that dependent work is not prioritised differently in each portfolio.

cells.title: Reallocate between portfolios
cells.detail: Uses outcome, cost and risk evidence to shift funding between portfolios for the next cycle.

cells.title: Portfolio strategy & themes
cells.detail: Adapts the enterprise themes to the portfolio and states what the portfolio wants to achieve.

cells.title: Fund value streams
cells.detail: Funds long-lived [[value-stream|value streams]] within the portfolio budget instead of approving every project individually (lean budgets).

cells.title: Portfolio Kanban
cells.detail: Reviews [[investment|investments]] against a [[benefit-hypothesis|benefit hypothesis]], approves them and sets their order within the portfolio.

cells.title: Track flow & capacity
cells.detail: Watches flow, capacity and dependencies across value streams and adjusts when work gets stuck.

cells.title: Balance RUN and CHANGE
cells.detail: Keeps the split of [[delivery-capacity|capacity]] between [[run-change|RUN and CHANGE]] deliberate, including modernisation and technical debt.

cells.title: Review outcomes, reallocate within
cells.detail: Compares expected and actual [[outcome|outcomes]] and shifts funding between value streams inside the portfolio.

cells.title: Receive budget & capacity
cells.detail: Value streams receive a stable budget and thereby a stable team capacity for the period, instead of funding per project.

cells.title: Plan team capacity
cells.detail: Value streams pull the prioritised investments into their plans according to available capacity.

cells.title: Build & release
cells.detail: Teams build and release products and platform changes. A delivered investment is an [[output]], not yet an outcome.

cells.title: Run, support & secure
cells.detail: IT operations runs, supports and secures the services, including incidents, resilience and compliance.

cells.title: Measure usage & outcomes
cells.detail: Collects usage, adoption and service quality as evidence of what was actually achieved.

cells.title: Cost baseline
cells.detail: Shows today's technology cost by solution and consumer as a starting point for strategic choices.

cells.title: Run cost & unit cost input
cells.detail: Provides run cost and unit cost so that budgets reflect what existing services really cost.

cells.title: Cost of options
cells.detail: Makes the cost of alternatives visible, including the cost of keeping legacy solutions running.

cells.title: Track change cost
cells.detail: Tracks the cost of change by value stream and investment.

cells.title: Allocate actuals to consumers
cells.detail: Distributes booked actuals from cost pools via towers and solutions to consumers ([[cost-allocation|cost allocation]]), including an explicit [[unallocated-cost|unallocated share]]; basis for [[showback]] or [[chargeback]].

cells.title: Unit cost & total cost of ownership
cells.detail: Shows the economics of what was delivered: unit cost and total cost of ownership over time.

cells.title: Capability map & target state
cells.detail: Links objectives to [[business-capability|business capabilities]] and describes the target architecture.

cells.title: Lifecycle & technology risk
cells.detail: Points out technologies reaching end of life and the risks that require mandatory investment.

cells.title: Dependencies & constraints
cells.detail: Shows architecture dependencies and end-of-life dates that constrain the order of work.

cells.title: Guardrails & platforms
cells.detail: Provides architecture guardrails and shared [[platform|platforms]] that teams build on.

cells.title: Lifecycle status & technical debt
cells.detail: Keeps the lifecycle status of [[application|applications]] and [[technology|technologies]] and the technical debt visible.

cells.title: Rationalise & decommission
cells.detail: Uses results to remove redundant applications and to complete replacements.

cells.title: IT cost target
cells.detail: Sets a top-down [[target]], for example a cost ratio, as orientation for planning.

cells.title: Approved budget
cells.detail: Budgeting approves the [[budget]] per period. It is not the same as actual cost.

cells.title: Rolling forecast
cells.detail: Forecasting updates the expected cost for the period on a rolling basis ([[forecast]]).

cells.title: Booked actuals
cells.detail: Accounting books the [[actual-cost|actual cost]], which TBM then allocates.

cells.title: Variance review
cells.detail: Compares forecast and actuals with the budget. A [[variance]] is calculated, never added to other values.

feedback.label: Outcomes, cost and risk evidence feed the next cycle of direction and funding.
